> Want to add it yourself? It is a great first contribution. See
> https://github.com/minkxx/AniKehai/blob/main/docs/adding-a-site.md

**Site name**
What is the name of the streaming site? (e.g., Crunchyroll, Aniwave)

**Site URLs**
Please provide the main URL, plus any known mirror/proxy links.
- Main URL:
- Alternate URLs:
- Example episode (watch page) URL:

**Video player (if you know it)**
Does the video play on the page itself, or inside an iframe from another domain? If it is an iframe, what is that domain?
- Player domain(s):

**Why should we add it?**
A clear and concise description of why this site should be supported (e.g., large userbase, 4K streams, ad-free).

**Additional context**
Any quirks? (Does it need a login? Use captchas? Sit behind Cloudflare? Hide cover images?) Anything that helps the integration.
